data.title: What hosts ask us.
items: Yes. Turn on applications, ask your own questions, and approve, decline or waitlist each person. Approved guests pay to confirm.
How does the seating plan work?
Catch suggests tables of six with something in common and someone new, from what guests told you. Move anyone with a drag, and keep people apart if you need to.
Refunds follow the cancellation policy you set. If there’s a waitlist, the next person gets an offer for the seat.
